task: Make /compact and auto-compaction requests to Bedrock-backed Claude models via the SSO proxy avoid litellm UnsupportedParamsError by preserving or injecting the tools param in the proxy request normalizer.

key_reasoning.reason: Open design decisions: the repro agent codemie-code is not in the Claude normalizer's client list, no Bedrock signal exists in the plugin context so the condition must be body-shape only, dummy tool schema is undefined, and server-side modify_params state is unverifiable from this repo.

No existing handler touches tools. Nearest pattern is the handler shape in claude-request-normalizer.plugin.ts, which mutates sampling/effort/thinking params and does not cover injecting content that alters upstream model behavior. Injection would apply to all backends (Vertex/Anthropic-direct), and tool-schema validity is unchecked.
